name: All eight validation gates
fail_closed_condition: a failing gate keeps the strategy on paper

name: Prospective sample
definition: at least 100 settled tickets across at least 8 distinct weeks
fail_closed_condition: a short, dense sample cannot be distinguished from a lucky run

name: Flat ROI
fail_closed_condition: the neutral stake must already be profitable

name: Bootstrap bound
fail_closed_condition: the interval, not the point estimate, decides

name: Survives both staking rules
definition: flat and past-only adaptive stake must agree in sign
fail_closed_condition: requirement R7-05: a sign flip under staking is an artefact

name: Evidence tier
definition: LIVE requires an authenticated, timestamped quote for every ticket
action: Demote immediately if any settled ticket lacks an authenticated quote.

name: Drawdown
definition: Cumulative loss measured in flat 1-unit stakes since promotion
action: Demote on the ticket that breaches the limit.

name: Loss streak
action: Demote on the last loss of the run.

name: Recency
definition: Flat-stake ROI over the trailing 25 settled tickets
action: Demote when the trailing window closes below the floor.

name: Signal
definition: Hit rate minus break-even rate, in standard errors
action: Demote when the price-free signal turns significantly negative.

name: Staking fragility
definition: ROI under a past-only adaptive stake against the flat stake
fail_closed_condition: sign of the flat ROI differs from the adaptive ROI over the same tickets
action: Demote: a result that only exists at one stake size is a staking artefact.

name: Sample decay
definition: Tickets settled since the last rule or data change
fail_closed_condition: fewer than 25 tickets since the last change
action: Return to PAPER and re-qualify; a changed rule is a new entrant.
